name: @melite/harness-provisioner
description: Vanilla-DSH provisioner for the inference.cpp media stack: one bundle mounts the estate row (in-process seats, no second process), the tool surface, the card view/deck, media previews, and the runs gallery — and the infer-provision bin renders ready-to-boot profiles (inference / headless / estate / melite-test) into any DSH_HOME.
